name: 3DGS Voxelizer
definition: A pipeline that converts a 3D Gaussian Splatting scan (`.ply` or `.spz`) into colored voxel blocks represented as OpenUSD PointInstancer data, allowing for visualization and physics collision in NVIDIA Omniverse.
summary: The 3DGS Voxelizer converts 3D Gaussian Splatting scans into OpenUSD PointInstancer voxel blocks, enabling physics-enabled interaction and collision detection in Omniverse.
